subject: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@brickline.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As discussed, Brickline used ~60% of the pilot allowance and we agreed to: (a) apply a remaining promotional credit to future invoices through June, and (b) return the residual in our ledger as a handback/contra item.

Quick asks so we can align with ops and accounting:
- Can you confirm whether Brickline prefers a credit memo applied to the next invoice (preferred by Sales) or an outright refund to the payment method?
- There are three legal entities on the contract (US, EU, and APAC billing entities). We need to know which entity should receive the credit memo or JE allocation. If you want to net at consolidation, please confirm the entity we should book the contra-revenue to.

I attached the draft allocation workbook showing proposed splits by entity and the promo terms. If you sign off, we’ll route to Marcus & Karthik to determine G/L mapping and whether to reverse any deferred revenue.

Appreciate a quick reply today so we can keep the billing cycle intact.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Allowance_Allocation_workbook.xlsx, Brickline_promo_terms.pdf
From: Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@brickline.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing AP <billing@brickline.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the workbook. Quick answers:
1) We prefer a credit memo applied to the next invoice rather than a refund. That keeps our AR tidy.
2) The contract references the US entity (Brickline Inc.) for billing, but our internal finance team wants the credit split shown across the three entities in our consolidation pack. For your purposes, please issue the credit memo against the US legal entity; we’ll handle intercompany reallocation on our side.

I copied our AP alias for visibility. We confirm sign-off on the allocation you proposed (60% used, 40% remaining). Please proceed.

Best,
Ava Sullivan
Finance Lead, Brickline Analytics

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2027 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment

Folks —

Thanks Naomi & Ava. Per Brickline’s preference to receive a credit memo against the US legal entity, here are the accounting considerations I need input on before we create the CM: 

1) Recording method: do we book the remaining allowance as a contra-revenue credit on the month-end invoice (reducing recognized revenue), or as a reduction to deferred revenue with a reversal entry (JE) that net-zeroes when applied to future invoices? The latter preserves revenue recognition but keeps a deferred balance until applied.

2) G/L mapping: if we do contra-revenue, proposed account is 4050-PromoAllowance. If deferred, propose 2350-DeferredAllowances. Karthik — any tax or revenue recognition constraints here given the promo ran across pilot period?

3) JE template: I attached a CSV we can drop into Netsuite if we go the JE route. If we issue a credit memo, Ops will create CM and link to the original invoice.

I recommend deferred revenue route for clarity on P&L trends (so month-end revenue stays clean), but we should confirm tax impact.

-Marcus
Sr. Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ERP_JE_template.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment

Marcus / team —

Agree with Marcus’s guidance to treat as deferred allowances (2350) rather than immediate contra-revenue. Rationale:
- Promo was an explicit allowance tied to future usage; treating as deferred aligns with ASC 606 principles and avoids stamping a revenue reversal in the P&L immediately.
- Brickline confirmed they want to apply the credit to future invoices, so an applied deferred credit maps cleanly.
- For tax: minimal impact this quarter; however, if Brickline later requests a cash refund we’ll need a reclass JE (deferred -> cash refund / AR adj) and additional tax reporting.

Action items:
- Marcus: please prepare the JE entries to book the 40% remaining allowance into 2350 (split by legal entity placeholder as US=100% on our side per Ava). Use the ERP_JE_template.csv.
- Naomi: confirm final CM narrative for audit (reference original promo code & pilot dates).
- Grace: please prepare CM creation instructions for Ops and include the account code to map in Netsuite.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Accounting

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ava Sullivan <ava.sullivan@brickline.io>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Allowance handback: allocation across entities & deferred revenue treatment

All —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary & next steps: 
- Brickline confirmed credit memo against US entity (Ava). We will not issue a cash refund.
- Accounting will book the 40% remaining allowance to 2350-DeferredAllowances on 3/31 (Marcus to post JE using ERP_JE_template.csv).
- Ops to create a credit memo (CM-8721) referencing DL-8721-NB and the promo code; Grace to share CM creation steps with Ops by end of day 3/18.
- Naomi to attach the signed allocation workbook and place final docs in the Drive folder HS-Record-345672 for audit.

If anything changes (refund request or entity routing), log a fresh thread and loop Legal & Tax.

Thanks,
Naomi
